documents.title: Estate Distribution Statement
documents.content: Final estate accounts and distribution statement prepared by Ashby Legal LLP as solicitors to the executors of the estate of the late Arthur Hughes, who died on 29 August 2023. Grant of probate issued 16 April 2025. Gross estate GBP 1,005,000.00, comprising the deceased's residence, cash at bank, National Savings and a portfolio of quoted shares. Less inheritance tax paid GBP 0.00, funeral, legal and valuation costs GBP 12,900.00 and settled liabilities. Net distributable estate GBP 992,100.00. Under the will dated 1 May 2018, Eleanor Hughes receives a 33% share of residue, GBP 330,700.00, paid to the beneficiary's nominated account on 8 December 2025, reference EST-2025-5134. Interim distributions already made are shown in the accounts. The beneficiary has signed a receipt and release. This statement is provided to the firm as documentary evidence of the origin of the funds now being invested. Any income arising during the administration period is reported on form R185.

documents.title: Declaration of Trust Summary
documents.content: Summary of the declaration of trust establishing The Hughes Nieces Trust, executed 15 June 2024. Settlor Eleanor Hughes. Initial trust fund GBP 695,000.00 transferred from the settlor's account at Halcyon Bank plc on 28 June 2024. Trustees Eleanor Hughes and the settlor's brother. Beneficiaries the settlor's nieces in equal shares absolutely. The trust is an interest in possession trust with the settlor's spouse as life tenant. The trustees have delegated investment management to NevisWealth Asset Management under a separate agreement and have agreed an investment policy consistent with the beneficiaries' ages. The trust has been registered on the Trust Registration Service and the trustees have obtained a unique taxpayer reference. The settlor is excluded from benefit. This summary was prepared by the trustees' solicitors for the investment manager's records and is not the deed itself.
